value.title: Château de Selles-sur-Cher
value.extract: Château de Selles-sur-Cher (French pronunciation: [ʃɑto də sɛl syʁ ʃɛʁ]) is a castle (château) located in the commune of Selles-sur-Cher, Loir-et-Cher, Centre Region, France. The château is privately owned and is a designated historical monument of France.
